name: Kayse for Claude
description:
Kayse is the Client Relationship AI for Plaintiff Firms. ⚖️

You cannot fix what you cannot see. Kayse dashboards show you the part that matters most: which cases make you money, and which marketing brought them in. 📊 Then Kayse lets you act on what you learn, right in the same platform.

This connector brings Kayse into Claude, so you can just ask for what you need.

What you can do:

📈 Build live dashboards on the fly and see which case types, sources, and ad spend actually pay off
⚡ Answer new leads fast with speed-to-lead outreach, so no lead goes cold while you are busy
🔄 Win back ghost clients with reactivation campaigns that reach the people who stopped answering
🗂️ Look up and update cases, clients, and case lists in seconds
💬 Send text and email updates that keep clients informed and happy
📞 Check call logs, recordings, and campaign results to see what is working

Kayse is the only client platform for plaintiff firms that pairs a full client portal with AI that makes calls for you. 🤖 Its AI Receptionist handles the whole intake, no handoff needed. Its outbound AI wins back the cases that go quiet, which is close to 40% of cases every year at many firms.

Ask Claude to build a dashboard, set up speed-to-lead workflows, send a client update, start a reactivation campaign, or check how your numbers look. Kayse does the rest. 🚀

_published_faq.name: How do I add Kayse for Claude to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Kayse for Claude to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://public-api.kayse.ai/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Kayse for Claude MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kayse for Claude lists 93 MCP tools, including add_client_to_case, append_clients_to_case_list, attach_cases_to_case_list, call_analytics, campaign_analytics, clone_case, compute_dashboard, convert_template_pretty_names, create_agent, create_case, create_case_list, and create_case_status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Kayse for Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Kayse for Claude in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Kayse for Claude MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kayse for Claude requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Kayse for Claude is developed by Case Connect Group LLC DBA Kayse. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
